CONTRACT TERM: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party if Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.

NDA:
[0] Non-Disclosure
[1] Agreement
[2] Date:
[3] Parties: [NAME OF INDIVIDUAL RECEIVING INFORMATION] of [address of individual] and FRODSHAM TOWN COUNCIL whose registered office is at CASTLE PARK HOUSE, CASTLE PARK, FRODSHAM, WA6 6SB (the Discloser)
[4] The Recipient shall not disclose the fact that this Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
[5] 1. The Discloser intends to disclose information (the Confidential Information) to the Recipient solely for the purpose of recommending the future use of the decommissioned play area on Ship Street, and for no other land, planning or project purpose (the Purpose).
[6] 2. The Recipient undertakes not to use the Confidential Information for any purpose except the Purpose, without first obtaining the written agreement of the Discloser.
[7] 3. The Recipient undertakes to keep the Confidential Information secure and not to disclose it to any third party, except that the Recipient may share Confidential Information with its employees, advisers, auditors and subcontractors who need it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement.
[8] 4. The undertakings in clauses 2 and 3 above apply to all of the information disclosed by the Discloser to the Recipient, regardless of the way or form in which it is disclosed or recorded but they do not apply to:
[9] a) any information which is or in future comes into the public domain other than through any act or omission of the Recipient or its representatives, or as a result of a breach of this Agreement by the Recipient; or
[10] b) any information which the Recipient can show by written evidence was already known to the Recipient and which was not subject to any obligation of confidence before it was disclosed to the Recipient by the Discloser.
[11] 5. The Recipient shall notify the Discloser in writing before making any disclosure of the Confidential Information that it is required to make by law, regulation, judicial process or a competent authority, to the extent legally permitted; shall disclose only the portion it is legally required to disclose; and shall seek confidential treatment for it where available.
[12] 6. On the earlier of request from the Discloser and completion or termination of the Purpose, the Recipient will return or destroy all copies and records of the Confidential Information, will not retain any copies or records of it, and will certify such destruction in writing.
[13] 7. Neither this Agreement nor the supply of any information grants the Recipient any licence, ownership interest or other right in or to the Confidential Information or any intellectual property rights of the Discloser.
[14] 8. The undertakings in clauses 2 and 3 will continue in force for sixty (60) months from the date of this Agreement. Any obligations that survive the end of this Agreement shall survive for at least twenty-four (24) months after such end. The Discloser shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief and other equitable relief for any actual or threatened breach of this Agreement, in addition to any other remedy.
[15] 9. This Agreement is governed by, and is to be construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware, unless the General Counsel approves otherwise.
[16] The Receiving Party may develop, acquire or market products or services similar to those of the Disclosing Party, and may acquire information similar to the Confidential Information lawfully from an independent third party, provided that in doing so it does not use or disclose any Confidential Information of the Disclosing Party.
[17] The English Courts will have non-exclusive jurisdiction to deal with any dispute which has arisen or may arise out of, or in connection with, this Agreement.
[18] Signed and Delivered as a Deed by:
[19] [name of Recipient] in the presence of:

CONTRACT TERM: The Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.

NDA:
[0] Confidentiality Agreement
[1] This Confidentiality Agreement (the “Agreement”) has been prepared on behalf of bpost SA/NV, a limited liability company of public law, and the City of Brussels (the “Sellers”) with regard to the divestment of their respective surface areas (the “Sale”) in the Munt Center/Centre Monnaie (the “Munt”).
[2] In consideration of the Sellers agreeing to disclose confidential information (the “Confidential Information”) to the Candidate (“Disclosee”), the latter hereby undertakes to the Sellers that as Disclosee, they will keep confidential all and any Confidential Information received at any time.
[3] The Disclosee will procure that prior to the disclosure to any other person (including any professional advisor) of any Confidential Information, such other person is made aware of the provisions of this Agreement and the fact that the Disclosee will be liable.
[4] The Disclosee may make copies of Confidential Information where its engineers need them to do the work.
[5] The Disclosee shall not reverse engineer any samples, tooling, prototypes or software that embody the Sellers' Confidential Information.
[6] The Disclosee acknowledges that the Confidential Information, in as far as it relates to bpost SA/NV, could be price sensitive information and ensures compliance with the relevant legal and other provisions in this respect (including, without being limited to, the provisions of the Belgian Law of 2 August 2002 on the supervision of the financial sector and on the financial services in relation to insider dealing and market manipulation).
[7] Confidential Information shall mean the following:
[8] a) all such information, of any kind whatsoever (whether in oral, written or electronic form, and including, but not limited to, technical, commercial, financial, accounting, legal and administrative information) pertaining to the Sale of the Munt and the Sellers as may be provided to the Disclosee and their responsible managers, officers, employees, shareholders, members of the Board of Directors and advisors (including financial, legal and tax advisors and auditors) (“Representatives”), by the Sellers, their advisors or their representatives;
[9] b) all such analyses, compilations, forecasts, notes, memoranda and other documents as the Sellers or Deloitte Real Estate* and Laga** (the “Advisors”) may have prepared or caused to be prepared and which may contain, refer to or simply result from, the information mentioned in point
[10] (a) above;
[11] c) the fact that the Disclosee (or any of their Representatives) are or have been involved in the analysis of, in meetings or negotiations related to the Sale, the contents, time and status of such negotiations, and generally any fact concerning the Sale.
[12] Confidential Information shall exclude:
[13] a) information which had become available to the public prior to the date of disclosure thereof to the Disclosee or their Representatives, or that became available to the public after such date other than as a result of a breach of this Agreement by the Disclosee or their Representatives;
[14] b) information which was lawfully in the Disclosee’s possession or in the possession of one or more of their Representatives prior to disclosure under this Agreement, in each case on a non-confidential basis, which, to their knowledge was free of any restriction as to its use or disclosure.
